name: Pastel Pearl Fascinator
description: A lovely party hairpiece featuring a soft green ribbon bow decorated with shiny pearls. The center is highlighted with sweet pastel flowers with pearl centers, paired with soft, colorful feathers that add a fun, airy touch.
description2: It is lightweight, comfortable to wear, and clips securely into hair to add a fancy finish to any party outfit. This headpiece can be customized in any color to perfectly match your little girl's dress.
